title: Anthropic quietly pitches draft bill to limit how Washington halts dangerous AI models: Report
hook_text: Anthropic pitched a draft bill in Washington
script:
Anthropic just pitched a draft bill to shape how Washington regulates AI.
The proposal focuses on setting boundaries for government intervention on models like Claude.
CEO Dario Amodei is navigating new policy discussions around federal oversight.
The leaked legislative text outlines how safety measures should be handled by officials.
Lawmakers in Washington are reviewing the newly circulated documents.
Should private labs help write government policy rules?
